The '''Battle of Roche''' was an early battle of the [[Jedi Civil War]], a conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan's]] [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]]. It took place following the [[Battle of Foerost (Jedi Civil War)|sacking]] of [[Foerost/Legends|Foerost]] as new battlefronts opened up across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] because of the advancing Sith Empire. The Sith advanced on Roche and conquered the planet. At the highest extent of the Sith Empire, Roche remained under Imperial control.<ref name="EA" />

{{Battle-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Battle of Roche makes its only appearance in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''.<ref name="EA" /> An exact date is not provided for the battle. The Battle of Foerost, however, is placed in [[3958 BBY]] by the ''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''.<ref name="KotORCG">''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''</ref>
